question: Why are these women also called holders of the staff?
premises: Their heads were touched by a staff.
The act of staff-touching defines a status.
A name is derived from that act.
inference: Because their heads were touched by the staff, they are also called daṇḍinīs.
uncertainties: The exact nominal form 'daṇḍinya' is taken as given in the text.
plain_english: Because their heads were touched by the staff, they are also called staff-holders.
